description: Semantic node/edge proposals for Hyprland knowledge graph, identified during architectural review on 2026-05-13. These capture design patterns, cross-cutting concerns, and architectural relationships that an AST-only extraction would miss.

proposed_nodes.label: Singleton via Global Inline Pointers
proposed_nodes.rationale: The implicit singleton pattern used by 21+ managers (g_pCompositor, g_pPluginSystem, etc.) is a key architectural invariant not captured as a named node.

proposed_nodes.label: Signal/Slot Observer System
proposed_nodes.rationale: CHyprSignalListener-based observer pattern used pervasively for event propagation (window lifecycle, focus, config reloads). Not captured as a semantic concept in the graph.

proposed_nodes.label: Lua-C++ Bridge Layer
proposed_nodes.rationale: The metatable-based C++-to-Lua translation layer (userdata, registry refs, signal-to-callback translation) is a significant architectural component.

proposed_nodes.label: std::expected Error Propagation
proposed_nodes.rationale: The error handling architecture using std::expected<SConfigError> is a pervasive pattern. actionError() and configError() are god nodes in the graph but their semantic relationship is not captured.

proposed_nodes.label: Render Pass Pipeline
proposed_nodes.rationale: CRenderPass collects IPassElement instances and renders them with damage-based simplification and occlusion culling. This pipeline pattern crosses 11 pass element types.

proposed_nodes.label: Configuration Data Flow
proposed_nodes.rationale: The end-to-end path from hyprland.conf file to affecting runtime state (via IConfigManager -> IValue -> consumer) is semantic metadata not captured in call graphs.

proposed_nodes.label: Plugin Extension API Surface
proposed_nodes.rationale: The HyprlandAPI namespace defines the contract for dynamic extensions. Individual API functions appear in the graph but the namespace-as-extension-surface semantic is absent.

proposed_nodes.label: Focus State Machine
proposed_nodes.rationale: CFocusState with 15+ eFocusReason values is a centralized state machine that inputs, config actions, layout algorithms, and compositor events all feed into.

proposed_nodes.label: Animation System Pipeline
proposed_nodes.rationale: The lifecycle from CAnimationPropertyConfig -> CAnimatedVariable<T> -> scheduleTick() -> frameTick() -> render-time value read is a template-driven pipeline.

proposed_nodes.label: SP/WP Ownership and Lifetime Pattern
proposed_nodes.rationale: The PHLWINDOW/PHLWINDOWREF, PHLLS/PHLLSREF, etc. type alias system encodes ownership semantics (SP = owning, WP = non-owning observer) throughout the codebase.

proposed_edges.rationale: g_pCompositor instantiates the global singleton pattern
g_pPluginSystem instantiates the global singleton pattern
CLuaEventHandler bridges C++ CHyprSignal to Lua callbacks
CProtocolManager uses m_modeChangeListeners (signal listeners) for monitor mode changes
actionError() is the primary error creation point for the config action system
configError() defines the base error type that actionError delegates to
CRenderPass implements the render pass pipeline
IPassElement is the composable unit in the render pass pipeline
IConfigManager is the entry point for the configuration flow
Lua CConfigManager implements IConfigManager for Lua-based config
addTiledAlgo is a plugin extension point for layout algorithms
createFunctionHook is a plugin extension point for function hooking
addDispatcherV2 is a plugin extension point for keybind dispatchers
CInputManager drives focus changes via mouse movement and refocus()
